top_issues.reason: Shell completion for long options written with '=' is broken in both bash and zsh. In zsh it removes the option the user typed. Has a clear reproducer and expected-behaviour tables.

records.judge_reason: Most of the report's themes are coherent and close to the labelled ones. The parser theme gathers the parser rewrite issues together with the chain and parsing bugs (#1269, #90121, #1322, #473). That is defensible, because those bugs come from the parser. #531 (augment_usage_errors) is a less natural fit there. The context and completion theme merges two labelled themes, but the merge is reasonable since all of its issues concern context.params access. #928 (dynamic choice) is arguably misplaced in it. Splitting async into its own theme and grouping prompts with stdin handling are both coherent choices. Putting help formatting together with exception colour is a moderate merge. The 'Misc utilities' theme is the weakest: it mixes the path and atomic-file parameter-type issues with test-runner terminal width and the WSL launch bug, so it reads as a catch-all. Overall the groupings mostly hold up, with a few misplacements, one catch-all theme and some merges.

File handling keeps both of its issues. The Click 9.0/internals theme is split into a project meta group and a typing/i18n group, which is a sensible split. Help output is mostly intact. The errors-and-exceptions theme is dissolved: #2740 and #2419 are merged into help output ("error message formatting"), which is somewhat defensible, but #2853 is put under shell completion, where it doesn't belong. #2402 (resolve_command) is also misplaced in completion. The commands/context theme is broken up: #2801, #2783 and #2753 are folded into parsing, which blurs that theme, and #2361 (embedding with custom streams) goes to file I/O, which is partially defensible. The parser meta issues #2835 and #2834 are separated from the parsing theme. Overall the themes are coherent but noticeably mixed, with a few clear misplacements.

themes.name: Parser behaviour and future parser design

top_issues.reason: Completing long options written as --opt=value is broken in bash and zsh, and in zsh it deletes the option. The issue has clear steps to reproduce.
Users see a full traceback during tab completion when get_command calls ctx.fail. Seen in real use (SONiC CLI).
The AliasedGroup example in the docs crashes with an AttributeError during completion when a command name has a typo. Both a docs fix and a code fix are proposed.
LazyFile opens and closes the file early to check for errors, so reading a FIFO fails depending on timing. A fix is proposed.
Meta issue for future parser changes, with the most discussion (15 comments). Several parsing issues depend on it.

records.judge_reason: Parameter types/files is matched exactly. Help output, parser and typing/i18n broadly correspond to labelled themes, but two labelled themes are dissolved. 'Errors and exceptions' is split: #2853 goes into shell completion, and #2419/#2740 go into help output. 'Commands, context and embedding' is scattered: #2753, #2801 and #2783 are lumped into the parser theme, #2402 into completion, and #2361 into typing. The completion theme therefore mixes unrelated tracebacks and resolve_command bugs, and the parser theme is bloated with context and invocation issues. #2823 is missing from the report. Several themes match, but others mix unrelated issues.
